decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction date of the 'Douglas County Courthouse' without specifying a state. The provided sources describe four distinct courthouses with this name in different locations, each with a unique construction date: 1) Douglas County Courthouse (Nebraska) has conflicting claims in the source text (D1S2 states 1912, D2S2 states 1895), both referring to the same entity but presenting contradictory data; 2) Douglas County Courthouse (Wisconsin) was built in 1918-1919 (D3S2); 3) Douglas County Courthouse (Illinois) was completed in 1913 (D5S2). As distinct valid referents exist for the same named entity in different jurisdictions, and the source text contains a direct contradiction for the Nebraska location, all four dates are preserved as complementary answers corresponding to their specific contexts.
